integrity: Six complete text reports and a standalone Python 3 checker embedded; all byte counts and SHA-256 hashes are computed on decoded bytes.
scientific_limitations: Exact adjacency-swap isolated states only. All-length proof is combinatorial, finite checker is corroborative. Does not cover channel coding performance, even-length graph connectivity or unknown historical equivalences.
title: Frozen adjacent-swap states in ternary short-tandem-irreducible words
